confirmation: only after observed targeted benefit; not launched by this controller
candidate-run: after all baseline cohorts are qualified and every budget is frozen
target-benefit: At least one determinate targeted failed-to-passed comparison. Cost reductions alone do not establish a new skill benefit.
artifact-baseline: Original source fixture and trusted contract/consumer/identity characterization precede any model mutation.
activation-boundary: Closed output syntax does not establish internal activation, and no forced procedure-zero result counts as benefit.
